scope: All 12 existing GarmentCode native garment families, named components and valid meta-compositions retain their 2D source and gain native offline assembled 3D preview/real sewn correspondence, existing experimental materials/UI/cancel/OBJ behavior and verification. This ledger does not shrink the goal to four currently routed families.
method: Static current-source review plus inspection/hash validation of recorded artifacts; no claim that every numerical suite was rerun during this audit.

styles.name: Shirt 宽松上衣
styles.currentEvidence: 2D generator present; generic flat mesher validates representative front/back torso panels only.
styles.remaining: Runtime torso/arm placement, neck/arm openings, all real center/shoulder/side seams, full 3D solve and App route are missing.

styles.name: FittedShirt 合体上衣
styles.currentEvidence: 2D generator and representative flat darted torso meshes present.
styles.remaining: Bust/waist darts, strapless support and complete source-facing sewn assembly have no garment-level 3D proof or App route.

styles.name: StraightWB 直条腰头
styles.currentEvidence: Separate source particles and actual side sewing are wired. Default+2 mm seam perturbation pass alongside FittedWB (4 CLI cases total). Native UI medium/soft verified.
styles.remaining: Full catalog width/waist and low-rise regimes, additional bodies and composed outfits remain unverified; upper edge remains a numerical fixed support.

styles.name: FittedWB 贴体弧形腰头

styles.remaining: Same catalog/combination gaps as StraightWB; it is not already sewn to skirts/pants/tops.

styles.name: SkirtCircle 圆裙

styles.remaining: Catalog suns 1..1.95, cuts, low rise and combinations remain unsupported. New factory nil-limiter physics and .5/1 3D not verified. Replace/extend App route only after end-to-end proof.

styles.name: SkirtManyPanels 多片裙

platform.name: 二维裁片 → 人台周围初始装配
platform.currentEvidence: Circle/WB/Skirt2 have specialized initializers. Imported JSON retains placement fields; newly generated PatternFile deliberately sets translation/rotation zero and includes_3d_placement=false.
platform.remaining: General source-faithful placement for torso/arms/legs/darts/tiers/inserts/collars and valid imported rotation/translation is absent. A flat mesh alone does not satisfy this step.

platform.name: 源边长/面积/质量/完整源 SHA 与三角法向
platform.currentEvidence: PreparedInput validates all panels, disjoint particles, complete source boundaries/stitches, directed faces, mass and same collision/render body; read-only panelBindings retained. 38 negative/cancel/budget cases recorded.
platform.remaining: Each new factory must pass this full factory with its complete document and supply actual runtime integration evidence; do not bypass for complex shapes.

platform.name: 真实缝合方向、正反面和连续普通边
platform.currentEvidence: Sewing accepts explicit A/B direction and rightWrong metadata; WB genuine ordinary seams accepted. Legacy skirts are welded controls.
platform.remaining: Current adapters reject rightWrong=true. All actual non-WB seams, mixed facing, one-to-many subdivided interfaces and same-panel darts require explicit known mappings and integration. Weldequal seams alone cannot prove independent sewing.

platform.name: 同源人体距离场/面接触/布片自接触
platform.currentEvidence: Full visible closed-body mesh and SDF, actual body triangle intersection checks and cloth contact tests exist. Body-surface report covers 8 skirt cases, not all clothes.
platform.remaining: New sleeves/collars/crotch/tiers/layered regions need discrete final intersection and independent inside/outside/centroid tests plus visual pose checks. Current scheme does not provide continuous collision guarantees.

platform.name: 人体尺寸与姿态
platform.currentEvidence: Full CC0 mesh is visible; fitting uses height/waist/hips/hips_line/_waist_level with bounded scaling, same body used for rendering/contact.
platform.remaining: Bust, underbust, neck, shoulders, arms/wrists, thigh/crotch and arm_pose_angle do not independently fit this mannequin. Upper/leg assembly needs either dimension-consistent fitting or explicitly validated body-shape limits; no personal scan is required.

platform.name: 柔软/中等/挺括实验面料
platform.currentEvidence: 120/180/280 g/m² numerical presets, SI reference area mass, compliance/damping and material regeneration are implemented. Supported garment UI preset changes recorded.
platform.remaining: No measured cloth calibration (user explicitly accepted experimental presets). Verify each new garment remains stable and preserves area/mass under all presets. Do not turn lack of unavailable sample measurements into a requirement for this phase.

platform.name: App 旋转/缩放/接缝/人体显示/复位
platform.currentEvidence: RealityKit native preview and actual supported-skirt/WB UI records exist; WB close camera handles full-body orbit bounds.
platform.remaining: Composed garment/full-body framing, upper/lower/hood/extreme sleeves views, multi-component seam identity and all new UI routes need final native verification.

platform.name: 离线后台生成/进度/取消/失败
platform.currentEvidence: Task.detached, progress callback, runID freshness guards, cancellation and visible quality/failure summary present. Core cancellation tests exist.
platform.remaining: Complex preparation is still actor-bound; measure UI responsiveness/cancel during meshing, preparation and long multi-panel solve, plus no stale result after dismiss/configuration change.

platform.name: 实际 3D 数据导出
platform.currentEvidence: OBJ metre/Y-up cloth+body export and local Files export proven for soft Skirt2 and StraightWB.
platform.remaining: All new multi-panel source identities, faces/normals, seams and final geometry need export/reimport verification. OBJ currently uses one cloth object name with skirt/WB cases; add appropriate full-garment naming. GLB/AR are not explicit newly authorized deliverables.

platform.name: 重复生成/保存的输入与输出来源
platform.currentEvidence: UI holds output and temporary OBJ for current view; no 3D cache/session archive was found in inspected 3D files.
platform.remaining: If repeated results/session saving are retained in current product plan, bind source/body/material/solver version to cached output and invalidate correctly; not required to reproduce obsolete Unity/GLB plan blindly.

platform.remaining: Physical device run, elapsed preparation+solve/render time, peak memory, responsiveness/thermal behavior and largest supported full garments remain unmeasured. Mac/Simulator timings are not a phone benchmark.

platform.remaining: For each completed family, compare same input source/panel topology, named 3D views and shape changes. Numeric 3D equivalence cannot be claimed without matched official body/material/final mesh; functional equivalent iOS backend remains allowed.

platform.remaining: After shared model/generator changes rerun affected 2D/printing gates and show current source paper/export bytes unchanged. Existing 356-pattern 2D claim is not 3D coverage.

bodyDerivedFormulas._bust_line: (1 - 1.0/3) * vert_bust_line + (1.0/3) * bust_line; when vert_bust_line is absent: bust_line

recordedProof.note: All recorded generated artifacts remain intact. Mesher/Input factory source changes mean the old manifest remains a historical run, not automatic proof of the current whole tree. New end-to-end proofs must record the new source hashes; do not edit old hashes to imply a rerun.

completionEvidenceRequired: Every supported garment family and named discrete component has actual full-source placement, sewing and App routing; no panel/component is silently omitted or approximated by another style.

Representative default nonempty meta selections (80 known 2D combinations), both existing body profiles, each named component choice and critical size/rise/ruffle/cut limits have explicit 3D outcomes. Distinguish geometric/physical input failures from unsupported implementation gates; do not require all infinite continuous combinations to settle.
Complete source SHA/bindings/edge rest lengths/area/mass/source-facing normals and real seam gap/fold freedom are independently checked for each new integration.

Original convergence gates remain: strain <8%, sustained speed <.025 m/s, penetration estimate <3 mm, actual independent seam gaps <.5 mm, nondegenerate mesh, final cloth and body crossings zero; inspect actual positions and independent body volume samples, not only counters.
Native preview and OBJ saved through UI match the actual completed output; body/material changes invalidate results, cancel prevents stale publication, source 2D/PDF behavior remains intact.
New family views and parameter response are compared with pinned source/reference behavior; matched official 3D numerical parity is explicitly unproven unless evidence becomes available.

Current Release simulator and generic iOS builds plus actual target iPhone performance/interaction evidence cover the new completed family scope; Mac/Simulator timings alone do not satisfy phone measurement.
